notes.title: A Little Perspective - new game from the developer of Sensorium
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's been a while since Sensorium came out in 2020. I'm happy to announce that I'm working on another puzzle game called A Little Perspective, which just had its trailer and store page launched.

It's a very different game from Sensorium, but shares much of the same DNA - it's full of surprising moments, challenging puzzles, and even some secrets. tl;dr It's another game that I can't share too much of without spoiling it!

If you're interested in this kind of game, give it a wishlist, and look out for a demo in the coming months :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3485300/A_Little_Perspective/
